#undefeatedheavyweight #2019boxingprospect #knockout
Filip  Hrgovic, Joe Joyce, Arslanbek Makhmudov, Efe Ajagba, Bakhodir Jalolov, Daniel Dubois , Ivan Dychko,  Tony Yoka, Vladyslav Sirenko, Nathan Gorman , and Trey Lippe Morrison are the current undefeated knockout kings of heavyweight this year. Some of them will be crowned the new heavyweight champion in the near future.
